items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XIII, List of Answers on Topics 23:1
items.html: The Izka [ring] is the Mem of Tzelem, meaning the four Mochin HB HG, for there is no coupling in the HG to draw the illumination of Hochma into Bina, and they are considered two Mochin; and this is the secret of the closed Mem of the large Lamed, which expands into "the growing of the government" (marbeh hamisrah) that comes in the Masorah. And this operates only in the GAR of the Mochin, called AVI and the Yod of HaVaYaH. But in the VAK of the Mochin, which are YESHSUT and the Hey of HaVaYaH, they are discerned as three Mochin, because the HG is considered in them as one Mocha, since they couple together to draw the illumination of Hochma into Bina, and therefore they are called the Lamed of Tzelem, namely three Mochin: HBD, each with a Yod in it, which amount in gematria to Lamed [30]. As above in the words of the Rav, page 1, column 1, Items 127, 136, and 137. (Vol. 1, p. 323, Item 65).
